description: This file contains functions related to user management in the TestLink project, including session handling, user retrieval, password reset, role management, and permission grants.

methods.name: setUserSession
methods.description: Sets session data after user modification or authorization, including handling test project and test plan cookies.

methods.name: getUsersForHtmlOptions
methods.description: Retrieves a map of users formatted for HTML options, with optional filtering and additional options.

methods.name: buildUserMap
methods.description: Builds a user display name map suitable for HTML select inputs, optionally including inactive users and additional options.

methods.name: resetPassword
methods.description: Resets a user's password in the database, optionally sending it via email or displaying it on screen.

methods.name: getUserErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns a human-readable error message based on user-related error codes.

methods.name: getAllUsersRoles
methods.description: Retrieves all users with their roles, with optional ordering.

methods.name: getTestersForHtmlOptions
methods.description: Returns users with roles that have rights to execute test cases within a specific test plan and project.

methods.name: initialize_tabsmenu
methods.description: Initializes a tab menu object with default permissions set to zero.

methods.name: getGrantsForUserMgmt
methods.description: Determines user and role management rights for a user, considering specific test project and plan permissions.

methods.name: setUserSessionFromObj
methods.description: Wrapper to set user session data from a user object.
